name: Aurelia Sync
overview: Efficient library synchronisation for the Aurelia music client.
description: Gives the Aurelia music client a resumable, ordered, idempotent view of the Jellyfin music library: a stable initial snapshot followed by an ordered change stream, delivered as bounded NDJSON segments with cumulative acknowledgement and per-client checkpoints. The plugin only ever reads from Jellyfin.
